description: Fetch the ExchangeRebel premium data bundle. $0.05 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/api/data. Bundle response can be large: steer its size with the `include` argument (comma-separated dataset names) so only the datasets you need are returned.
name: data_bundle
